headline: Source candidates need reasons, not mystery ranking.
copy: The future retrieval layer should return why a candidate matched, what was rejected, and what still blocks display.

steps.title: Score source
steps.copy: Rank source candidates with explicit reasons.

steps.title: Reject overreach
steps.copy: Show rejected source paths when they are unsafe.

steps.title: Return packet
steps.copy: Send only source packets to the adapter.

candidates.title: Results feel uncertain
candidates.reason: Matches steady action, outcome attachment, and non-therapy boundary.

record.title: Steady action
record.summary: Supports practical answers about steady action while avoiding promises of guaranteed calm.
record.boundary: Reflection support only; not therapy, ritual instruction, or spiritual command.

candidates.packet:
Fixture runner result
Query: How can I act calmly when results are uncertain?
Candidate: Bhagavad Gita 2.48
Accepted because: steady action and outcome boundary match.
Rejected: medical calming claim, guaranteed peace claim.
Reviewer state: approved

candidates.title: Oppenheimer quote source
candidates.reason: Matches quote-category correction and public trust example.

record.title: Oppenheimer category correction
record.summary: Supports correcting the common claim: the famous line is associated with the Gita, not the four Vedas.
record.boundary: Do not call it a direct quote from the four Vedas.

candidates.packet:
Fixture runner result
Query: What scripture did Oppenheimer quote?
Candidate: Bhagavad Gita 11.32
Accepted because: source category correction is clear.
Rejected: four Vedas direct quote.
Reviewer state: approved

record.title: Gayatri mantra care
record.summary: Useful for source context, but learner-facing practice needs reviewer and rights review.
